{
  "categories": [
    {
      "name": "build",
      "member": true,
      "evidence": "Removes Boost.Test build configuration from depends/packages/boost.mk, contrib/guix/libexec/build_linux.sh, cmake/module/AddBoostIfNeeded.cmake, and vcpkg.json.",
      "band": "P3",
      "score": 0.4,
      "reason_tag": "cleanup",
      "rationale": "Simplifies dependency management across Guix, depends, and CMake by eliminating Boost.Test. As noted in the description, removing the dependency reduces maintenance overhead and improves toolchain compatibility for linters."
    },
    {
      "name": "ipc",
      "member": false,
      "evidence": "Touches src/ipc/test/ipc_tests.cpp only via a mechanical include replacement.",
      "band": "Unranked",
      "score": 0.0,
      "reason_tag": "cleanup",
      "rationale": "Mechanical test include updates do not touch IPC interfaces or process-separation architecture."
    },
    {
      "name": "kernel",
      "member": false,
      "evidence": "Touches src/test/kernel/test_kernel.cpp only via a mechanical include replacement.",
      "band": "Unranked",
      "score": 0.0,
      "reason_tag": "cleanup",
      "rationale": "Mechanical test include updates do not touch libbitcoinkernel APIs, boundaries, or kernel library tests."
    },
    {
      "name": "tests",
      "member": true,
      "evidence": "Introduces an in-tree test runner and assertion framework in src/test/util/framework.{h,cpp} and src/test/main.cpp to replace Boost.Test.",
      "band": "P2",
      "score": 0.65,
      "reason_tag": "cleanup",
      "rationale": "Replaces Boost.Test with an in-tree assertion framework and runner, addressing longstanding tracking issues #34666 and #8670. Reviewer josibake notes this 'removes barriers to writing tests and enables concurrency improvements to speed up CI', while resolving failure diagnostic omissions and platform signal stack quirks."
    },
    {
      "name": "tools",
      "member": false,
      "evidence": "Only touches contrib/guix/libexec/build_linux.sh, which is part of the Guix build system.",
      "band": "Unranked",
      "score": 0.0,
      "reason_tag": "cleanup",
      "rationale": "Build and release scripts under contrib are governed by the build category, not tools."
    },
    {
      "name": "wallet",
      "member": false,
      "evidence": "Touches wallet test files only through mechanical include updates.",
      "band": "Unranked",
      "score": 0.0,
      "reason_tag": "cleanup",
      "rationale": "Mechanical include replacements in wallet test files do not modify wallet behavior or test logic."
    }
  ],
